property_summary: Invariant: Calling Command(...) as the Owner never changes the contract's Owner state (Owner remains the original deployer) — the delegatecall mutant can break this by executing code that overwrites Owner.
change_summary: Change the call from low-level call to use delegatecall so the executed code runs in the context of this contract, allowing that external code to modify this contract's storage including the Owner variable exposed via Command.
